integrity: Exact combinatorial enumeration, acyclic Hasse check, integral Morse coordinates, Smith invariants, determinant-one certificate, 48 integral action matrices and independent Lefschetz character checks. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact computation for the single 24-vertex permutahedral graph; the previously known sphere-wedge homotopy and vertex-deletion splitting are background, not new claims. Rational decomposition does not imply an integral direct-sum splitting; novelty remains limited by inaccessible or unindexed work.
title: Shortest crosspolytopal carriers and integral octahedral symmetry in the truncated-octahedral independence complex
